entities.summary: Nauru is a sovereign nation in Micronesia, Oceania. Its capital is Yaren (de facto; no official capital). Official languages include Nauruan, English. Government: Unitary parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 0.0 million. Area: 21 km². Comprehensive index for Nauru covering Micronesian/Polynesian settlement (~1000 BCE), 12 original tribes (12-pointed star on flag), German annexation (1888), phosphate discovery (1900), mandate to Australia/UK/NZ, WWII Japanese occupation (1942-45, 1,200 Nauruans deported to Chuuk), independence 1968, phosphate wealth boom (1970s-80s highest per capita income), phosphate exhaustion and economic collapse, Australian offshore detention centre (2001-present, asylum seekers, Pacific Solution).
